config.title: OMP Chat
config.model: Model passed to omp --model as provider/id, e.g. openrouter/baidu/ernie-5.5-flash-preview:free, openrouter/cohere/north-mini-code:free, deepseek/deepseek-flash. List them with `omp models openrouter`.
config.approvalMode: When omp must ask before running a tool. Changing it restarts omp and resumes the conversation.
config.approvalMode.always-ask: Ask before every file write/edit and command (read-only tools run freely).
config.approvalMode.always-ask-cached: Like always-ask, but approvals can be remembered for a file or folder.
config.approvalMode.write: Auto-accept file edits; ask before running commands.
config.approvalMode.plan: Plan mode: read-only; the agent writes a plan, and you approve it before anything changes.
config.thinkingLevel: Effort: how much the model thinks before answering (minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh or max; high by default). Models without reasoning ignore it. Changes apply to the running conversation.
config.announceSteps: Ask the agent to say what it is about to do before it uses tools, give short updates while it works, and sum up at the end (like Claude Code). Changing it restarts omp and resumes the conversation.
config.extraArgs: Extra CLI arguments appended after --mode rpc.
command.attention: Go to the Chat That Needs You
config.notifications: Show a notification when a chat needs your answer while it is hidden or VS Code is in the background, and when it finishes while VS Code is in the background.
